title: WEBCON – Operations
description: Daily / weekly overview for operations: host, Portal visits, top actions and paths, active tasks, external APIs.

links.title: Documentation
links.tooltip: Panel descriptions and how to read them (GitHub)

list.name: exclude_ports
list.label: Exclude ports
list.description: Regex of ports excluded from the external API panels. Default: OTLP export to Alloy (the stack's own telemetry) and Solr (8983 - WEBCON search index, also on a separate server).

list.name: exclude_hosts
list.label: Exclude hosts
list.description: Case-insensitive regex of hosts excluded from the external API panels. Default: localhost and the WEBCON host IP addresses (set by the installer) - internal WEBCON communication (Solr, Service modules). WEBCON host names (self_host variable) are always excluded.

list.name: self_host
list.label: WEBCON hosts
list.description: Names of hosts running Portal / Service (target_info) - calls to them are internal traffic (e.g. Portal -> Service :8002).

panels.title: Home page opens – today
panels.description: webcon.portal.open: Portal home page opens since midnight.

panels.title: Sign-ins – today
panels.description: aspnetcore.authentication.sign_ins since midnight. Sign-in ≠ visit: a user with a remembered session does not sign in again. One sign-in may be reported for several authentication schemes – the maximum scheme per instance is counted.

panels.title: Unique users (7 days)
panels.description: webcon.portal.request.user.unique.recently: users from the last 7 days, but not earlier than the application start (a Portal restart resets the counter). Last value in the time range – an idle Portal (IIS) does not export metrics. WEBCON does not provide a daily unique user count.

panels.title: Unique since Portal start
panels.description: webcon.portal.request.user.unique.since_start – since the last Portal process start.

panels.title: Opens and sign-ins per day
panels.description: Count per day (UTC days).

panels.title: Actions – top 10 by average time
panels.description: Span webcon.action.execute by action ID (WEBCON Designer Studio). Min and max – TraceQL metrics (traces, 8-day retention). Count, average, median, p95 – spanmetrics (histogram, values approximated to buckets). Median and p95 from the spanmetrics histogram (buckets = powers of 2) are approximate and may fall outside the Min–Max range (min/max are exact, from Tempo).

targets.expr: sum by (webcon_action_id, webcon_action_name) (increase(traces_spanmetrics_latency_sum{span_name="webcon.action.execute",webcon_action_id!="",service=~"$job"}[$__range])) / sum by (webcon_action_id, webcon_action_name) (increase(traces_spanmetrics_latency_count{span_name="webcon.action.execute",webcon_action_id!="",service=~"$job"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Top 10 actions – average time per day
panels.description: Average execution time per day for the 10 actions with the highest average in the time range.

targets.expr: (sum by (webcon_action_id, webcon_action_name) (increase(traces_spanmetrics_latency_sum{span_name="webcon.action.execute",webcon_action_id!="",service=~"$job"}[$__interval] offset -$__interval)) / sum by (webcon_action_id, webcon_action_name) (increase(traces_spanmetrics_latency_count{span_name="webcon.action.execute",webcon_action_id!="",service=~"$job"}[$__interval] offset -$__interval))) and on (webcon_action_id) topk(10, sum by (webcon_action_id) (increase(traces_spanmetrics_latency_sum{span_name="webcon.action.execute",webcon_action_id!="",service=~"$job"}[$__range] @ end() offset -$__interval)) / sum by (webcon_action_id) (increase(traces_spanmetrics_latency_count{span_name="webcon.action.execute",webcon_action_id!="",service=~"$job"}[$__range] @ end() offset -$__interval)))

panels.title: Paths – top 10 by average transition time
panels.description: Span webcon.elements_management.path.transitions by path ID; path, step, workflow and process names from the content database (WEBCON SQL data source). Min and max – TraceQL metrics (traces, 8-day retention). Count, average, median, p95 – spanmetrics (histogram, values approximated to buckets). Median and p95 from the spanmetrics histogram (buckets = powers of 2) are approximate and may fall outside the Min–Max range (min/max are exact, from Tempo).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CAST(p.PATH_ID AS varchar(20)) AS webcon_path_id, p.PATH_Name AS path_name, s.STP_Name AS step_name, w.WF_Name AS workflow_name, d.DEF_Name AS process_name
FROM dbo.WFAvaiblePaths p
JOIN dbo.WFSteps s ON s.STP_ID = p.PATH_STPID
JOIN dbo.WorkFlows w ON w.WF_ID = s.STP_WFID
JOIN dbo.WFDefinitions d ON d.DEF_ID = w.WF_WFDEFID

panels.title: Top 10 paths – average transition time per day
panels.description: Average transition time per day for the 10 paths with the highest average in the time range (path ID – names in the table above).

targets.expr: (sum by (webcon_path_id) (increase(traces_spanmetrics_latency_sum{span_name="webcon.elements_management.path.transitions",webcon_path_id!="",service=~"$job"}[$__interval] offset -$__interval)) / sum by (webcon_path_id) (increase(traces_spanmetrics_latency_count{span_name="webcon.elements_management.path.transitions",webcon_path_id!="",service=~"$job"}[$__interval] offset -$__interval))) and on (webcon_path_id) topk(10, sum by (webcon_path_id) (increase(traces_spanmetrics_latency_sum{span_name="webcon.elements_management.path.transitions",webcon_path_id!="",service=~"$job"}[$__range] @ end() offset -$__interval)) / sum by (webcon_path_id) (increase(traces_spanmetrics_latency_count{span_name="webcon.elements_management.path.transitions",webcon_path_id!="",service=~"$job"}[$__range] @ end() offset -$__interval)))

panels.title: Active tasks
panels.description: Current status from the content database (does not depend on the dashboard time range).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS active,
       ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN TSK_Overdue = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS overdue
FROM dbo.ActiveTasks
WHERE TSK_IsFinished = 0 AND TSK_IsDeleted = 0

panels.title: Users with the most active tasks
panels.description: Current status from ActiveTasks (not finished, not deleted). “Group” = tasks assigned to a group (TSK_ToGroup) – the login is then the group login.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 10 TSK_UserName AS user_name, TSK_User AS login, COUNT(*) AS tasks,
       SUM(CASE WHEN TSK_Overdue = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue,
       SUM(CASE WHEN TSK_ToGroup = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS group_tasks
FROM dbo.ActiveTasks
WHERE TSK_IsFinished = 0 AND TSK_IsDeleted = 0
GROUP BY TSK_User, TSK_UserName
ORDER BY tasks DESC

panels.title: Target servers – top 10 by call count
panels.description: Outgoing HTTP calls from Portal and Service (http.client.request.duration): REST/SOAP data sources and actions, authentication, licenses. Internal calls (Solr, Service modules - hosts from $exclude_hosts; Portal -> Service) and the stack's own telemetry (ports from $exclude_ports) are excluded.

targets.expr: 100 * (sum by (server) (label_replace(label_join(increase(http_client_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job",server_port!~"$exclude_ports",server_address!~"(?i)($exclude_hosts|$self_host)",error_type!=""}[$__range]), "server", ":", "server_address", "server_port"), "server", "$1", "server", "(.*):")) or (0 * sum by (server) (label_replace(label_join(increase(http_client_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job",server_port!~"$exclude_ports",server_address!~"(?i)($exclude_hosts|$self_host)"}[$__range]), "server", ":", "server_address", "server_port"), "server", "$1", "server", "(.*):")))) / sum by (server) (label_replace(label_join(increase(http_client_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job",server_port!~"$exclude_ports",server_address!~"(?i)($exclude_hosts|$self_host)"}[$__range]), "server", ":", "server_address", "server_port"), "server", "$1", "server", "(.*):"))

panels.title: Errors by server and type
panels.description: error.type: HTTP code (4xx/5xx), connection_error (connection refused or TCP connection timeout ~21 s – WEBCON does not distinguish them, only the duration differs) or name_resolution_error (DNS error).

panels.title: Calls per hour by server (top 10)
panels.description: HTTP calls per hour; the 10 servers with the most calls in the time range.

targets.expr: sum by (server) (label_replace(label_join(increase(http_client_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job",server_port!~"$exclude_ports",server_address!~"(?i)($exclude_hosts|$self_host)"}[$__interval]), "server", ":", "server_address", "server_port"), "server", "$1", "server", "(.*):")) and on (server) topk(10, sum by (server) (label_replace(label_join(increase(http_client_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job",server_port!~"$exclude_ports",server_address!~"(?i)($exclude_hosts|$self_host)"}[$__range] @ end()), "server", ":", "server_address", "server_port"), "server", "$1", "server", "(.*):")))

panels.title: Errors per hour by server and type
panels.description: Calls that ended with an error (error.type) per hour.

panels.title: p95 response time by server (top 10)
panels.description: 95th percentile of HTTP call duration in hourly windows.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (server, le) (label_replace(label_join(increase(http_client_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job",server_port!~"$exclude_ports",server_address!~"(?i)($exclude_hosts|$self_host)"}[$__interval]), "server", ":", "server_address", "server_port"), "server", "$1", "server", "(.*):"))) and on (server) topk(10, sum by (server) (label_replace(label_join(increase(http_client_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job",server_port!~"$exclude_ports",server_address!~"(?i)($exclude_hosts|$self_host)"}[$__range] @ end()), "server", ":", "server_address", "server_port"), "server", "$1", "server", "(.*):")))

panels.title: Data sources by total time
panels.description: Span webcon.data_source.data.load by data source ID and type. TraceQL metrics, dashboard time range. The trace shows the HTTP call and the target server.

panels.title: Data sources with errors
panels.description: Errors getting data from data sources (the "Error getting data for DataSource" exception in Portal / Service logs, one record per error). webcon.data_source.data.load spans never have the error status - the error is visible only in the HTTP span and in the log. Dashboard time range.

targets.expr: sum by (data_source_id, data_source, service_name) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$job"} | exception_message=~"(?s)Error getting data for DataSource.*" | scope_name!="Serilog.AspNetCore.RequestLoggingMiddleware" | line_format "{{.exception_message}}" | regexp "DataSource name: (?P<data_source>.*?) ID: (?P<data_source_id>[0-9]+)" [$__range]))

panels.title: Actions with HTTP call errors
panels.description: Actions (webcon.action.execute) in which an HTTP call returned an error (error.type: 4xx/5xx code, connection error, DNS). Action spans never have the error status - WEBCON may complete an action despite an HTTP error. Structural TraceQL query: approximate count (skips incomplete traces in Tempo). Dashboard time range.

targets.query: { span.error.type != nil } < { name = "webcon.action.execute" } | count_over_time() by (span.webcon.action.id, span.webcon.action.name, resource.service.name)
